decision.explanation: The question asks when the City of Maryborough was established. Document D1S2 explicitly states that the City of Maryborough existed as a local government entity from 1861 until 2008. Document D2S1 and D2S2 also support this by mentioning events in 1861 related to the development of the area. These sources directly assign the establishment year of the City of Maryborough to 1861, making it the only valid and supported answer.
